content.text: Card Bingo is a lottery-style card game where players try to match called cards to their hand. A caller draws cards and announces them; players turn down matching cards in their hand. First player to turn down all cards wins. Similar to traditional number Bingo but using playing cards.

Card Bingo adapts the traditional number-based Bingo lottery game to use standard playing cards. The basic concept of matching called items to a card grid translates naturally to matching called cards to a hand. Various versions have evolved with different dealing patterns, betting structures, and win conditions.
Basic game: up to 10 players plus caller. Large groups: 60+ players possible with multiple decks and tables. Caller can be a player or dedicated.
Basic: Two standard 52-card packs without jokers (one for dealing, one for calling). Large groups: Multiple packs as needed. Some variants use one deck with suits ignored.
2+ decks of cards, chips/money for betting variants
Basic: 5 cards face up to each player (6 cards if 8 or fewer players). One pack used for dealing. Second pack used by caller. Thirteen-card version: 13 cards each for larger games.
